assumptions.statement: Official overall and key-area polygons are not publicly supplied; all submitted boundary geometry is provisional.
assumptions.impact: Replace all scope and key-area polygons together, then regenerate every dependent layer, metric, figure, HTML and PDF.

assumptions.statement: The provisional Dazhongsi key-area centroid is approximately 2.26 km from Dazhongsi station in repository Issue #1029.
assumptions.impact: Treat station integration as a transferable mechanism only until official geometry is supplied.

assumptions.statement: Approved FAR, height, density, green ratio, setbacks, road redlines and statutory control lines are missing.
assumptions.impact: All such metrics remain null; concept ratios are explicitly non-statutory.

assumptions.statement: Authoritative parcels, ownership, existing buildings and retain-renovate-demolish surveys are missing.
assumptions.impact: Submitted footprints are program carriers, never current-building or demolition claims.

assumptions.statement: Verified heritage limits, protection zones and complete asset inventories are missing.
assumptions.impact: No protection line or heritage intervention is inferred; cultural content requires professional verification.

assumptions.statement: Official station interfaces, traffic counts, parking supply, crossings and road engineering are missing.
assumptions.impact: Mobility lines are conceptual walking/cycling links pending transport review.

assumptions.statement: Utilities, drainage, energy, fire access, flood and emergency constraints are missing.
assumptions.impact: Infrastructure proposals are service requirements, not engineering layouts.

assumptions.statement: No confirmed event calendar, operator, budget, procurement route or long-term steward is supplied.
assumptions.impact: T-90 to T+365 is a proposed accountability sequence, not an approved schedule.

assumptions.statement: No site visit, resident interview, accessibility audit or operator workshop was performed for this AI submission.
assumptions.impact: Human fieldwork is a precondition before design adoption or site-specific implementation.

assumptions.statement: No measured year-round public-value outcomes exist for the proposed 365 model.
assumptions.impact: Use counts and checkpoints as monitoring design only; do not claim impact.

assumptions.statement: International cases differ in law, land, finance and governance.
assumptions.impact: Use only clearly bounded mechanisms; no direct transplantation or success guarantee.

assumptions.statement: AI health, legal, safety and enterprise services have domain-specific professional and legal limits.
assumptions.impact: AI assists navigation and review; qualified humans retain decisions and stop authority.

assumptions.statement: Repository participation does not by itself establish unrestricted reuse rights for every input.
assumptions.impact: Submission uses COMMUNITY-DISPLAY-ONLY and records source-specific rights and limitations.

assumptions.statement: Implementation actors, ownership, approvals, finance and construction timing are unconfirmed.
assumptions.impact: Phasing polygons express evidence gates, not government commitments or construction dates.
